card.text: Rapidly rotating A-type star 5.13 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Altair spins so fast that its equator bulges to 2.03 solar radii while its poles sit at 1.63. Here it is a plain sphere of the same volume, 5.13 parsecs away.
